title: Encoding orders and trees in real-valued functions
summary: We prove function-theoretic analogues of a quantitative result of Hodges on extracting the order property from a sufficiently large 2-tree coded in a binary relation. Similar analogues for functions were previously obtained by Daskalakis and Golowich and by Anderson and Benedikt. These results are from statistical learning theory, where 2-trees are captured by sequential fat-shattering dimension, and the order property is controlled by various notions of "thresholds".
